name: A Dual-Ellipse Fitting Method for High-Accuracy Pupil Boundary Estimation
journal: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine (CMPB)
abstract: A dual-ellipse fitting method explicitly modeling the pupil's cylindrical 3D structure for high-accuracy boundary estimation under all viewing angles (0-80 degrees).
note: All 10 figures now generated from generate_all_figures.py using real dual-ellipse-fitting algorithm. Pipeline is fully reproducible.
